address: 5 Warwick Place, Little Venice, London, W9 2PX, United Kingdom
bio: It’s wise to book ahead if you want to join the Little Venice locals who have long known what a jewel they have in the form of this buzzy, busy Persian restaurant; be sure ask for the ground floor rather than downstairs. Sharing plates, fresh salads, satisfying stews and expertly chargrilled meats served with lovely fluffy saffron rice, are all on offer – you’ll leave feeling satisfied and sated, and your wallet won’t take a battering either....
